rules.name: Adaptive Defence
rules.description:
■ While a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is within a terrain area, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

■ Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units are entrenched while all of the following apply:

■ That unit is within a terrain area.

■ That unit was not set up this turn.

■ No model in that unit moved more than 3" this turn.

■ Friendly Darnath Lysander/Tor Garadon units have the following ability:

Defensive Mastery: At the start of each phase, this unit is entrenched.

DARNATH LYSANDER’s/TOR GARADON’s unit is always entrenched, regardless of the conditions listed above.

Restrictions: Your army can include Imperial Fists units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

rules.name: Mission Tactics
rules.description:
Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability have the following abilities:

Furor Tactics

If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Malleus Tactics

If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

Purgatus Tactics

If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of this unit have [PRECISION].

DEATHWATCH ALLIES

You can include Deathwatch units in your army, even though they do not have the same Chapter faction keyword as other units in your army. The combined points value of such units cannot exceed 500 points.

When mustering your army, unless otherwise stated, you cannot select a DEATHWATCH model to be your WARLORD. In addition KILL TEAM units can only contain enhancements taken from this detachment.

This an exception to the Space Marine Chapters Army Rules.

■ Otherwise you can:

rules.name: Lightning-fast Strike
rules.description: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder units have +2" M.

stratagems.name: Masterful Tactics
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can make a normal move of:

Up to D6".
Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

stratagems.name: Domination Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has shot.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next turn:

While a unit is suppressed, that unit’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Armour Of Contempt
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

rules.name: Tactical Mastery
rules.description: You can select the tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.

stratagems.name: Transhuman Swiftness
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.
stratagems.target: One friendly Tacticus unit that is within range of an objective and is eligible to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

stratagems.name: Tactical Focus
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to make a consolidation move.
stratagems.effect: When making that consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Relentless Assault
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s attacks have:

[Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].
Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

rules.name: Wrath of the Chapter
rules.description: Friendly Tacticus units can re-roll advance rolls.

stratagems.name: For The Emperor!
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly Tacticus unit that is within range of an objective.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Point-Blank Brutality
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged Tacticus unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [Blast] attacks) have:

[Close-Quarters].
[Ignores Cover].

stratagems.name: Relentless Assault
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s attacks have:

[Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].
Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

rules.name: Codex Fire-patterns
rules.description: Friendly Tacticus units’ [Rapid Fire] attacks benefit from [Rapid Fire] when targeting units up to that attack’s maximum range.

stratagems.name: Gunship Extraction
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged adeptus astartes terminator unit.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: Merciless Veterans
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly adeptus astartes Terminator unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:

[Lethal Hits].
[Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: Tactical Dreadnought Fortitude
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly adeptus astartes Terminator unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

rules.name: Death Blow
rules.description: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Terminator units have +1 to charge rolls.
